# Python UDF structure and scalar type mappings:
# https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/user-defined-functions-python
# Each case has its own persistent routine because scalar cases run concurrently.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.py_multiply(x FLOAT64, y FLOAT64)
RETURNS FLOAT64 LANGUAGE python
OPTIONS(runtime_version='python-3.11', entry_point='multiply') AS r'''
def multiply(x, y):
    return x * y
''';
SELECT scalars.py_multiply(2, 10)
=> "20.0"

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.py_bool(x BOOL)
RETURNS BOOL LANGUAGE python OPTIONS(runtime_version='python-3.11', entry_point='identity') AS r'''
def identity(x):
    return x
''';
SELECT scalars.py_bool(FALSE)
=> "false"

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.py_int(x INT64)
RETURNS INT64 LANGUAGE python OPTIONS(runtime_version='python-3.11', entry_point='identity') AS r'''
def identity(x):
    return x
''';
SELECT scalars.py_int(9223372036854775807)
=> "9223372036854775807"

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.py_min_int(x INT64)
RETURNS INT64 LANGUAGE python OPTIONS(runtime_version='python-3.11', entry_point='identity') AS r'''
def identity(x):
    return x
''';
SELECT scalars.py_min_int(-9223372036854775808)
=> "-9223372036854775808"

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.py_unicode(x STRING)
RETURNS STRING LANGUAGE python OPTIONS(runtime_version='python-3.11', entry_point='identity') AS r'''
def identity(x):
    return x
''';
SELECT scalars.py_unicode('日本語 🐍\x00')
=> "日本語 🐍\u0000"

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.py_empty_string(x STRING)
RETURNS STRING LANGUAGE python OPTIONS(runtime_version='python-3.11', entry_point='identity') AS r'''
def identity(x):
    return x
''';
SELECT scalars.py_empty_string('')
=> ""

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.py_bytes(x BYTES)
RETURNS BYTES LANGUAGE python OPTIONS(runtime_version='python-3.11', entry_point='identity') AS r'''
def identity(x):
    return x
''';
SELECT TO_HEX(scalars.py_bytes(b'\x00\xfb\xff'))
=> "00fbff"

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.py_empty_bytes(x BYTES)
RETURNS BYTES LANGUAGE python OPTIONS(runtime_version='python-3.11', entry_point='identity') AS r'''
def identity(x):
    return x
''';
SELECT TO_HEX(scalars.py_empty_bytes(b''))
=> ""

# Python's math module is part of the standard library; sqrt(9) = 3.
# https://docs.python.org/3.11/library/math.html#math.sqrt
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.py_sqrt(x FLOAT64)
RETURNS FLOAT64 LANGUAGE python OPTIONS(runtime_version='python-3.11', entry_point='root') AS r'''
import math
def root(x):
    return math.sqrt(x)
''';
SELECT scalars.py_sqrt(9)
=> "3.0"

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.py_rows(x FLOAT64)
RETURNS FLOAT64 LANGUAGE python OPTIONS(runtime_version='python-3.11', entry_point='multiply') AS r'''
def multiply(x):
    return x * 2
''';
SELECT SUM(scalars.py_rows(x)) FROM UNNEST([1.0, 2.0, 3.0]) AS x
=> "12.0"

# The documentation's logging example explicitly maps None to SQL NULL.
# https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/user-defined-functions-python#enable_logging
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.py_null_result()
RETURNS STRING LANGUAGE python OPTIONS(runtime_version='python-3.11', entry_point='f') AS 'def f(): return None';
SELECT scalars.py_null_result() IS NULL
=> "true"

# Python stdout, including native writes, must not corrupt the worker protocol.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.py_print(x STRING)
RETURNS STRING LANGUAGE python OPTIONS(runtime_version='python-3.11', entry_point='f') AS r'''
import os
import sys
def f(x):
    print('stdout')
    print('stderr', file=sys.stderr)
    os.write(1, b'native output\n')
    return x
''';
SELECT scalars.py_print('value')
=> "value"

# The Python UDF documentation explicitly excludes temporary functions.
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION py_temporary(x INT64) RETURNS INT64 LANGUAGE python
OPTIONS(runtime_version='python-3.11', entry_point='identity') AS 'def identity(x): return x';
SELECT py_temporary(1)
=> error:

# Observed BigQuery answers for NULL, return conversions, nonfinite values and exceptions.
# BigQuery exceptions include a service traceback; check the stable exception type and message.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.py_null_argument(x STRING)
RETURNS BOOL LANGUAGE python OPTIONS(runtime_version='python-3.11', entry_point='f') AS r'''
def f(x):
    return x is None
''';
SELECT scalars.py_null_argument(NULL)
=> "true"

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.py_overflow()
RETURNS INT64 LANGUAGE python OPTIONS(runtime_version='python-3.11', entry_point='f') AS 'def f(): return 2**63';
SELECT scalars.py_overflow()
=> error contains: Python int too large to convert to C long

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.py_float_from_int()
RETURNS FLOAT64 LANGUAGE python OPTIONS(runtime_version='python-3.11', entry_point='f') AS 'def f(): return 1';
SELECT scalars.py_float_from_int()
=> "1.0"

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.py_int_from_bool()
RETURNS INT64 LANGUAGE python OPTIONS(runtime_version='python-3.11', entry_point='f') AS 'def f(): return True';
SELECT scalars.py_int_from_bool()
=> error contains: Expected integer, got bool

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.py_nonfinite(x FLOAT64)
RETURNS FLOAT64 LANGUAGE python OPTIONS(runtime_version='python-3.11', entry_point='f') AS 'def f(x): return x';
SELECT FORMAT('%T', scalars.py_nonfinite(CAST('NaN' AS FLOAT64)))
=> "CAST(\"nan\" AS FLOAT64)"

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.py_negative_zero(x FLOAT64)
RETURNS FLOAT64 LANGUAGE python OPTIONS(runtime_version='python-3.11', entry_point='f') AS 'def f(x): return x';
SELECT IEEE_DIVIDE(1, scalars.py_negative_zero(-0.0))
=> "-Infinity"

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.py_exception()
RETURNS INT64 LANGUAGE python OPTIONS(runtime_version='python-3.11', entry_point='f') AS 'def f(): raise ValueError("bad input")';
SELECT scalars.py_exception()
=> error contains: ValueError: bad input
